data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of USD 3,314.9m. There was effectively no material gross prioryear reserve movement identified in the gross claims development table (net prioryear movement assessed as flat). The 2016 result was, however, affected by major natural catastrophe losses (Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods and Gatlinburg wildfires) which together contributed US$56.0m of major losses in 2016. Gross written premium for the year was USD 1,912.2m.
raw_causal_phrases: reduced levels of favourable ultimate premium development on prior years compared to 2015.

The Syndicate combined ratio increased to 99.5% (2015: 91.4%), principally reflecting US$56.0m of major losses (2015: US$nil). Major losses incurred by the Syndicate were Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods and Gatlinburg wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding) and are unambiguous. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision' line was found; the gross claims development triangle (note 9) was used as the primary source and indicates effectively zero gross prioryear development for underwriting years up to 2014. The P&L/claims reconciliation table includes a 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' gross line of -34.9 (USD) which was not used per instruction (that row is a P&L claims-incurred figure, not the reserve movement). The development triangle in the PDF is presented in a staggered/diagonal layout; some rows for the most recent columns are blank - cells that could not be unambiguously read were set to null in the triangle. All monetary figures are reported in the report's native currency (USD) in millions.
